newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen approves two Kerr-McGee deals.
newsitem.headline: Yemen approves two Kerr-McGee deals.

text.p: Yemen's parliament has approved two production-sharing deals with the Yemen subsidiary of Kerr-McGee Corp which were signed between the U.S. company and the Sanaa government in March, a newspaper said on Friday.
The official al-Thawra newspaper said parliament had approved the deals in its session on Thursday.

According to the deals, which were signed on March 13 and approved by the Yemeni cabinet on March 19, Kerr-McGee Yemen Ltd will operate East Al Hajar (Block 51) and Hazar (Block 50), covering about 10 million acres.
Kerr-McGee will have a working interest of 87.5 percent in Block 51 and 95 percent in Block 50.
